blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Nearly 3,000 police officers will be deployed across Mimaropa to secure cemeteries, transport hubs and other public areas during All Saints’ Day (November 1) and All Souls’ Day (November 2). The MIMAROPA police are implementing security measures in more than 200 cemeteries, memorial parks and columbaria, as well as churches, major roads, tourist destinations and transportation terminals. “Our priority is to ensure that families can pay their respects to their departed loved ones in a safe and peaceful environment,” said Police Brig.
